0.name: TEXT_DUNGEONFESYOJINBO_00000_YOJINBO_000_000
0.description: For far, far too long have I waited for this rematch!
0.translation_description: Era da troppo, troppo tempo che attendevo questa rivincita!

1.name: TEXT_DUNGEONFESYOJINBO_00000_YOJINBO_100_000
1.description: The Soboro Sukehiro may have brought us together, but 'twas fate that<hex:02100103>ordained we engage in glorious fisticuffs─but with swords!─once more!
1.translation_description: La Soboro Sukehiro ci avrà anche riuniti, ma è stato il destino a volere che<hex:02100103>ci affrontassimo ancora in uno scontro glorioso: a mani nude─anzi, a colpi di spada!

2.name: TEXT_DUNGEONFESYOJINBO_00000_YOJINBO_000_001
2.description: Victory will be mine this day!

4.name: TEXT_DUNGEONFESYOJINBO_00000_GILGAMESH_000_011
4.description: I throw myself upon your boundless mercy and beg forgiveness! Please!
4.translation_description: Mi affido alla vostra immensa clemenza e imploro il perdono! Vi prego!
